name: Jonathan
description: Son of Mattathias, surnamed Apphus; accompanied Judas his brother into the country of Galaad

points: They heard what Judas and Jonathan were doing and wanted a name of their own.
Nobody sent them. The spirit was on Judas and Jonathan, not on them, and they went under the guise of good intentions.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
